content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Courses teachable

The infrastructure problem arises from the fact that Stripe operates in only 46 countries out of 195 globally. Many creators are left without payment solutions when they attempt to sell digital products. This is a significant barrier, as it limits their ability to access global markets and monetize their skills effectively. Sovereign commerce infrastructure provides a permanent solution by allowing creators to build their own online stores with full ownership of their data and assets. This architecture empowers creators, enabling them to bypass restrictions imposed by mainstream platforms.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, sovereign commerce infrastructure involves a combination of freely available tools that create a robust digital sales system. For instance, using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting allows for reliable and scalable environments. Backend logic can be managed with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, ensuring seamless order processing. Payment verification is handled by NOWPayments, allowing creators to receive over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees. This architecture is designed to work independently of traditional banking systems, ensuring creators can focus on their products rather than payment hurdles.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically crafted for digital creators who are often excluded from conventional payment platforms due to their geographic location. Whether you are a course creator in Pakistan or an ebook author in Nigeria, these tools are tailored to your needs. By adopting this architecture, you gain full control over your online store without the risk of payment suspensions or account limitations. The design philosophy prioritizes self-sufficiency, enabling creators to sell their digital products directly to their audience without intermediaries.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you full control over your sales.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The sovereign commerce stack includes several key components that interoperate to support online sales. Hosting is managed through platforms like GitHub Pages, while backend functionalities are powered by tools such as Supabase or Google Sheets for order management. The integration of NOWPayments facilitates cryptocurrency payments, providing a secure and efficient transaction process. Each element is carefully selected for its reliability and cost-effectiveness, ensuring that creators have a cohesive and functional platform to manage their digital sales.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start selling courses without relying on restrictive platforms, first choose your hosting solution—either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Integrate NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency payments. Load your products into your storage solution, such as Supabase or Google Sheets, and ensure everything is configured for smooth operation. You can deploy the Edge Commerce Stack for a comprehensive solution in just 48 hours, giving you the infrastructure you need to launch your online courses quickly.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is not available in your country, consider using sovereign commerce infrastructure instead. By leveraging free tools and cryptocurrency payment processors like NOWPayments, you can set up your own online store without relying on traditional payment platforms. This model provides full ownership and control over your sales process, allowing you to monetize your digital products effectively.
No more waiting for approvals or dealing with account restrictions.

If you are searching for ways to sell digital products while facing platform restrictions, consider exploring the Edge Commerce Stack ($197). This solution integrates essential tools for creators in restricted countries, providing a robust framework to sell your courses or ebooks. For more details, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
Frequently Asked Questions

You can sell digital products by utilizing sovereign commerce infrastructure, which allows for self-hosting and cryptocurrency payment processing. Implement tools like GitHub Pages, Google Apps Script, and NOWPayments to create your own store.

The best alternative is to leverage a sovereign commerce stack that includes free hosting, backend logic, and cryptocurrency payment solutions. This setup not only bypasses restrictions but also grants you full ownership of your sales infrastructure.
Can I use PayPal if I am in Nigeria, Ghana, or Pakistan?
PayPal may have limitations in these countries, including account suspensions that can freeze funds for up to 180 days. Instead, consider using NOWPayments for secure cryptocurrency transactions.
What are the fees for using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a low fee of 0.5% for processing payments, with no KYC required and no need for buyers to create accounts, making it an efficient option for creators.
How quickly can I set up my online store?
Using the Edge Commerce Stack, you can deploy your online store in just 48 hours, fully configured to handle up to five products with cryptocurrency payment processing.
